technical.summary: QCOM shows bullish momentum with strong volume spike and three white soldiers pattern, but overbought oscillators and price below 200-MA create pullback risk; moderate confluence with weak trend structure limits swing entry conviction.

fundamental.summary: QCOM shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 57 days—fundamentals lack bullish catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (VIX-equivalent score 12) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is minimal and mixed with no conviction signal; news data unavailable to confirm setup.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds with VIX in crisis territory (360.96), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, and earnings event in 57 days create a highly unfavourable risk environment for QCOM.

debate.key_bull_argument: Three white soldiers + 15x volume spike + bullish OBV/supertrend/PSAR create genuine momentum confirmation in extreme fear environment (VIX crisis), offering contrarian entry near support at 125.18.
